scope: Synthetic keyring secrets; real encryption and authenticated engine restore with a fake database adapter. No key bytes are recorded.

tests.name: missing key inspection never generates a replacement master
creation stores random owner-only 32-byte master and derives stable context key
normal status contains no master or derived passphrase
explicit offline export verifies secret file without printing key bytes
same private master and folder derive the same key on another server
server-folder key creates an authenticated image without storing any key in manifest or site
provisioned destination restores actual image bytes and database value
wrong random server master fails before target file or DB mutation
same master but different folder context fails before target file or DB mutation
different folder context has a different nonsecret key identifier
public-root key storage is rejected before a directory or key is created
public-root key export and import are refused
key permissions are validated without silently widening or repairing them
symbolic-link key files are never followed
symbolic-link keyring directories are refused
invalid key lengths fail instead of replacing the old file
existing different keys and existing export paths are never overwritten
publicly readable keyring directories are rejected without chmod changes
invalid folder contexts cannot select arbitrary key files
parallel first use produces one stable master without a replacement race
actual private master and derived key do not appear in distributable source
